subject: Weekend celebration — summer 2027
body:
Hi,

My partner Felix and I are exploring Hotel Hesselet for a full-weekend celebration in summer 2027 — around 100–120 guests, most of them flying in from the US.

We're thinking Friday evening arrival gathering, a proper Saturday dinner and dancing, and a Sunday morning send-off. Ideally we'd have exclusive use of the property across both nights.

A few things we'd love to know:
- How many guests can stay overnight on site?
- If the on-site rooms don't cover our full group, is it possible to set up an outdoor tent to accommodate everyone for the Saturday dinner?
- Do you have availability in mid-to-late June 2027, or open dates in July?

Any information on weekend buyout pricing would be wonderful too.

Many thanks,
Robyn & Felix
